description: A sixteen-step sequencer holding sixteen polyphonic channels, with one row of knobs standing for whichever step is current

params.text: Moves to the next step, wrapping back to the first after the last
Moves to the previous step, wrapping to the last from the first
Sets how many steps are played before the sequence wraps, 1 to 16
Sets how many channels come out, 1 to 16
Sets the voltage of one output channel at the current step, -10V to +10V; it is rewritten from the store each time the step changes

inputs.text: Moves to the next step on each rise past 2V
Moves to the previous step on each rise past 2V
Returns to the first step on each rise past 2V

outputs.text: The values of the current step, with as many channels as the Poly knob is set to

notes: only the current step is on the panel: the sixteen knobs hold that step's values and jump to the next step's values as the sequence moves, so the other steps are edited by stepping to them
the sixteen lights show which step is current, counted left to right along each row and then down
a fresh module has every step at 0V on every channel, so the output is silent until knobs are turned

inputs.0:
high above 2V · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
